description: List or search StackOverflow / StackExchange tags with question counts and synonym info — top tags by popularity, tags matching a name fragment, or stats for specific tags. Answers "most popular StackOverflow tags", "how many questions are tagged X", "which tags have more than N questions". Example: stack_tags({ sort: "popular", limit: 20 }) or stack_tags({ inname: "python" })

_apiKey.description: Optional — a StackExchange API key (free, 10k/day) for a dedicated quota. The gateway supplies a platform key; pass your own only to override.

inname.description: Filter to tags whose name contains this fragment, e.g. "python"

min_count.description: Only return tags with at least this many questions (server-side when sort=popular)

tags.description: Exact tag names to look up, semicolon-separated, e.g. "java;python;rust"

name: stack_tags
